title.why: The release and the Kamerstuk name the Uitvoeringswet AI-verordening; both are announcements, labelled alt-official.

note: Both sources are announcements of a draft bill and are labelled alt-official, so level B is right. The draft's own text cannot be stored (robots.txt), and original_title stays unsupported by stored text, as the extractor says. A search found only consultation responses (Raad voor de rechtspraak of 15 Jul 2026, Raad van State section of 8 Jul 2026) and no formal submission of the bill; status Draft / proposed stands.
